# Inactive upstream workflows

These 19 historical SolidCraft workflows are reference material. GitHub does not
execute workflows in this directory. This includes release, packaging, generated
files, browser/wasm, corpus, native workspace and nightly matrix suites.

Do not move them back or dispatch equivalent heavy jobs without a new explicit
owner request and a reviewed resource budget. FABER's sole active workflow is
`../workflows/faber-ci.yml`. See `../../docs/faber/CI.md`.
